name: @w6w-apps/gladia
description: Transcribe pre-recorded audio and video with Gladia: submit a job, poll its result, list and delete jobs, and register a remote file.

w6w.longDescription: Gladia is a speech-to-text API for audio and video. This app starts pre-recorded transcription jobs from an audio URL (with language selection, speaker diarization, subtitles, translation, summarization, sentences, named entities, sentiment, custom vocabulary and spelling, PII redaction and a completion callback), reads a job's status and result, lists and deletes jobs, registers a remote file with Gladia, and lists the available models. Live (WebSocket) streaming is not covered.
